name: Agent cap
author: Brett
description: A configurable cap on how many headless Claude sessions and builds run at once on the VPS (agent-slots@1, framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs). Extras wait in a queue (FIFO within boss / urgent / normal / low) and start by themselves when a slot frees and memory allows; finished sessions don't count and close by themselves (logs kept). Settings (hot-reloaded): max running agents, max heavy test/build steps at once, memory guard, close-after, priority rules; shown in Settings → Plugins → Agent cap and in the Breakroom (Agent swarm) settings. Slots used / cap in the activity banner's summary, the queue (position, waiting since, Move up, Cancel) on the Builds page, 'waiting for a desk' on swarm agents past the cap, and a systems-check item when the memory guard trips often or swap stays in use. VPS hard build limit (build-limit@1): the host refuses the N+1st headless build whatever the queue thinks (default 8, one config file), runs every build in axf-builds.slice (CPUQuota, MemoryMax) and caps docker test containers; live usage on the settings tab, banner chip and queue title; only Brett's signed-in console changes it.

items.title: VPS hard build limit
items.description: The VPS's hard limit on headless builds running at once, live usage (what really runs on the host: claude -p trees, sessions starting up, launches just admitted), what counts, and the axf-builds.slice CPU / memory caps and docker test-run limits. canEdit says whether this caller may change it (only Brett's own signed-in console).

items.title: Set the VPS hard build limit (Brett only)
items.description: Brett only, from his own signed-in console: change maxBuilds (default 8), cpuQuotaPct, memoryMaxGb, memoryHighGb, tasksMax, dockerCpus, dockerMemoryGb, dockerImages. Sessions, MCP and voice (the console token) get 403.
